question: Where and with what should the deity-mantra be written?
premises: The deity-mantra is the object to be written.
The hair-parting is the specified location.
A bright pigment is the specified instrument.
inference: One should write the deity-mantra on the hair-parting with bright pigment.
plain_english: One should write the deity-mantra on the parting of the hair with surucā.
